name: strict-time-converter
title: Strict Time Converter
description: Convert Unix timestamps and Chinese/English dates with explicit ambiguity and daylight-saving checks.
author: leau_chou

commands.name: convert-time
commands.title: Convert Time
commands.description: Convert timestamps, ISO/RFC strings, and Chinese/English dates locally. Reject ambiguous or invalid inputs.

preferences.name: timezone
preferences.title: Default Time Zone
preferences.description: Time zone for displaying results and parsing dates without an offset. Unix timestamps are independent of time zones.

preferences.name: dateOrder
preferences.title: Date Order
preferences.description: Interpret year-last dates such as 03/04/2026. The us: and eu: prefixes override this preference.

scripts.format: prettier --write src package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js README.md
